question: Which organizations, technical components and control roles make up Bitcoin?
answer: These selected component records distinguish organizations, network operation, asset or application controls and supporting services. A component connection does not transfer every legal obligation to the network; the complete family reference retains the other saved components.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.
